matches.description: This study follows heat flow across an interface with time-resolved X-ray scattering. The other study uses the same scattering technique on thin films, so its procedure carries over directly, though it asks how fast a lattice heats rather than how heat crosses a boundary.

this.intent: A material's heat flow shows in how its atoms scatter X-rays over time.
this.technique: Time-resolved X-ray scattering after a laser pulse heats one side of an interface.

other.intent: How fast a crystal lattice heats shows in how its X-ray scattering changes after a pulse.
other.technique: Time-resolved X-ray scattering of a thin film after optical heating.
